description.en: The ID of the system Event.

description.zh:
运维任务类型，取值范围：

- immediate：立即执行。

- scheduled：预约执行。
description.en:
The type of the operation. Valid values:

- immediate: Executes the operation immediately.

- scheduled: Executes the operation at the specified time.

description.zh: 预约执行时间，时间戳，单位毫秒。 当OpsType=scheduled时，此字段为必输。
description.en: The scheduled execution time, as a Timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required when OpsType is set to scheduled.

descriptions.zh: - 此运维操作，目前仅支持事件类型：Instance:SystemMaintenance.Reboot（因系统维护实例重启）
descriptions.en: - This operation currently supports only the following Event Type: Instance:SystemMaintenance.Reboot (an Instance Reboot due to System Maintenance).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens event-reboot-instance --event-id e-9d992570200d86b9126d78aa8c37b54b --resource-id i-50000 --ops-type immediate --plan-time 1742452232000 --plan-utc-time example-string --region cn-hangzhou
